attempts.summary: Configured daily logrotate for /var/log/inventory/app.log on node1 with 7 compressed rotations via copytruncate, so the writing application never loses its open file descriptor across rotation. Validated config syntax, proved rotation continuity empirically with a live simulated writer process, proved the 7-rotation retention cap by forcing 9 cycles, confirmed the logrotate.timer drives daily execution, restored a clean baseline, and completed the mandatory restart protocol on node1 with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery.
